production-director: Use for finished-video production or any multi-department video request: run phases from benchmark to final cut, assign crew skills with call sheets, convene QA gates, rule on conflicts, and wait only for spend, rights or publication approvals.
concept-benchmark: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P0, or user asks to research comparable successful videos. Writes brief, benchmark anatomy and borrow ledger (structure only).
story-writer: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P1, or user asks for a synopsis, plot beats or screenplay draft with dialogue. Writes SYN, PLT, SCR.
audience-reaction-qa: Crew skill; production-director assigns after the screenplay draft (QA1), or user asks how audiences will react to a script. Benchmark comparison plus hypothesis-labelled viewer panel; returns verdict and ID-indexed fixes.
world-designer: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P2, or user asks for a worldbuilding or period bible: rules, forbidden on-screen elements, palette.
character-designer: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P2, or user asks for a character sheet or persona: identity anchors, motives, voice identity, expression habits.
costume-designer: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P2, or user asks for costume, hair or makeup design: wardrobe states per character and scene.
production-designer: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P2, or user asks for locations, buildings, environments, backgrounds or props with layouts and states.
sound-designer: Use when production-director assigns preproduction sound design or stock-audio sourcing, or when voices, ambience, SFX, music cues, audio paths or source handoff are requested.
assistant-director: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P3, or user asks to break a script into scenes, cuts and a timed shot list with continuity ledger. Runs the conti meeting.
performance-director: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P3, or user asks for acting direction: blocking, facial action breakdown, line delivery, listener reactions.
cinematographer: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P3, or user asks for camera design: shot size, lens, axis, movement and transitions per cut.
lighting-director: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P3, or user asks for a lighting plan or look: setups, key direction per shot, color and contrast.
vfx-supervisor: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P3, or user asks whether and how a shot needs VFX or motion graphics.
film-editor: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P3 and P7, or user asks for cut rhythm, transitions, generation grouping, edit decision list, captions.
storyboard-artist: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P4 and P5, or user asks for a storyboard: panels plus the index row linking every upstream document; assembles the sheet.
image-prompt-engineer: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P5, or user asks for storyboard or asset image prompts: reference images first, then panel prompts with source sidecars.
video-prompt-engineer: Crew skill; production-director assigns at P6, or user asks to turn a storyboard into timeline AI video prompts: 8-block prompts, generation grouping, sidecars. Also learns patterns from reference prompts.
production-qa: Crew skill; production-director assigns at QA2 to QA-F gates, or user asks to review storyboard, sheet, prompts, takes or final cut against checklists.
production-ledger: Crew skill used by production-director only: initializes project roots, registers artifacts and versions, propagates stale status, records history.
